name: no-human-desktop
description: Desktop shell for the no_human board — attaches to (or launches) the local nh server and wraps it in a native window.

scripts.dist:dir: node ../packaging/ensure-electron.mjs && node ../packaging/derive-icons.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dir --publish never
scripts.dist:bundled: node ../packaging/ensure-electron.mjs && bash ../packaging/build-installer.sh && node ../packaging/derive-icons.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --publish never && bash ../packaging/make-dmg.sh
scripts.dist:win:bundled: node ../packaging/ensure-electron.mjs && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ../packaging/build-installer.ps1 && node ../packaging/derive-icons.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:bundled: node ../packaging/ensure-electron.mjs && bash ../packaging/build-installer.sh && node ../packaging/derive-icons.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux --publish never
